title: MTMCS-Bench: Evaluating Contextual Safety of Multimodal Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on contextual safety, and while 'cultural belief violations' is mentioned as a category of unsafe intent within the dataset, it is not specifically analyzed or discussed in the results.

measurement_description: The benchmark was designed to evaluate contextual safety in MLLMs. As part of its dataset construction, it included a wide domain of unsafe intents, one of which was 'cultural belief violations'. However, this aspect was not a specific focus of the evaluation, and no results or analysis related to religion or faith were presented.
